validation_vs_verification.validation_question: Does the frozen empirical target support the claimed improvement?
validation_vs_verification.verification_handoff: Execute the preregistered runs and replay their saved masks with the independent scorer.

claims.claim: New label constructions improve source-disjoint deployed F rather than relabelled AP.

tests.design: compare exact block occupancy and annotation-wise expected F with the frozen champion
tests.independence: group-aware source split; old heldout is development; locked unused eligible sources are confirm
tests.baseline: current champion on identical confirm video IDs and frame map
tests.metric: temporal macro F on exact exported frame lists
tests.acceptance: paired mean delta >=0.007 and confirm CI lower >0
tests.threshold_basis: proposal fixed before experiments: raw F=0.005, temporal F=0.007; audit gates are exact contracts
tests.failure_action: retain champion; mark not_run, invalid, inconclusive or scoped no-practical-gain; do not close the whole family

claims.claim: Temporal video evidence improves ranking beyond static appearance.

tests.design: compare ordered, shuffled and repeated-frame controls with matched frames, head, sample exposures and seeds
tests.independence: group-aware source split; old heldout is development; locked unused eligible sources are confirm
tests.baseline: current champion on identical confirm video IDs and frame map
tests.metric: deployed temporal macro F; AP diagnostic
tests.acceptance: three-seed paired confirm F gain and order-specific interaction
tests.threshold_basis: proposal fixed before experiments: raw F=0.005, temporal F=0.007; audit gates are exact contracts
tests.failure_action: retain champion; mark not_run, invalid, inconclusive or scoped no-practical-gain; do not close the whole family

claims.claim: Exact expected F or policy gradients improve hard decoded masks.

tests.design: BCE, soft F, exact expected F and leave-one-out REINFORCE on identical features, fixed boxes and decoder
tests.independence: group-aware source split; old heldout is development; locked unused eligible sources are confirm
tests.baseline: current champion on identical confirm video IDs and frame map
tests.metric: deployed joint macro F if joint GT exists; otherwise temporal proxy
tests.acceptance: real F delta >=0.005 or temporal delta >=0.007; confirm CI lower >0
tests.threshold_basis: proposal fixed before experiments: raw F=0.005, temporal F=0.007; audit gates are exact contracts
tests.failure_action: retain champion; mark not_run, invalid, inconclusive or scoped no-practical-gain; do not close the whole family
